name: @zstudio/app
description: Z Studio — cross-platform content-creation product for the ZOS ecosystem.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix tests && npm ci --prefix native
scripts.sync: npm run build && npm run sync --prefix native
scripts.build:android: npm run sync && cd native/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.test: npm run test:content-persistence --prefix tests -- ../app/my-studio.html && npm run test:app-theme --prefix tests -- ../app/my-studio.html && npm run test:preview-state --prefix tests -- ../app/my-studio.html && npm run test:mobile --prefix tests -- ../app/my-studio.html && npm test --prefix tests -- ../app/my-studio.html
